about_the_game:
It's been a long night and it's only going to get worse. Check in to the Motel Lapin and find yourself dragged to the nightmare worlds of The Warrens. Inside this labyrinth of interconnected realms, a cult of rabbit-headed men want to use you to help complete their incomprehensible project. You are fragile. A single slice of a knife will kill you and a cadre of monstrous fanatics stand between you and your freedom. However, you're not the only one trying to escape. Use your wits, help your fellow victims, and you may survive the night.

Features:

  • Use a host of unusual items to stun, push, and wound your captors.

  • Or use items on yourself and the environment to breathe underwater, silence your footsteps, and turn invisible.

  • Explore an industrial meat processing megastructure, the grounds of a decaying mansion, a conquered observatory, and more for a total of six interconnected, non-linear areas.

  • Discover hidden allies to help you survive.

  • Unravel the secrets of The Warrens.

content_descriptors.notes: The Warrens is a low-poly surreal horror game that features frequent but unrealistically presented gore and violence.  The main enemies in the game are cannibalistic and commit ritual suicide. They operate an industrial meat processing facility that uses captured, mutilated, people for labor.
